name: Gold ATM
short_description: Secure self-service kiosk for automated purchase and sale of certified gold products.
description: Gold ATM modernizes precious-metal retail by combining secure vaulting, real-time pricing, and touchless checkout flows. It is designed for malls, airports, and premium retail environments requiring trusted, autonomous transactions.

name: WTC Machines
short_description: High-uptime vending and micro-retail machine platform for transit hubs and campuses.
description: WTC Machines deliver an integrated commerce stack for autonomous retail. Operators can manage inventory, promotions, and telemetry from a centralized dashboard while customers enjoy frictionless purchases.

name: Police Smart Booth
short_description: Connected digital kiosk for first-response communication and civic services.
description: Police Smart Booth enables communities to access emergency support, digital complaint filing, and assisted citizen services around the clock. Built-in surveillance integration improves public safety response times.
features: Emergency video call with dispatch center

name: ResponseAI
short_description: Domain-trained conversational AI for customer support, triage, and engagement.
description: ResponseAI orchestrates multilingual, context-aware interactions across voice, chat, and kiosk channels. It combines retrieval, policy automation, and human handoff to deliver reliable user experiences.

name: Ainetra
short_description: Vision intelligence stack for operations, safety, and retail behavior analytics.
description: Ainetra transforms camera feeds into actionable intelligence with real-time detection, event scoring, and dashboard-ready insights. It is optimized for smart city and enterprise deployments.

name: EcoShelf
short_description: IoT-enabled intelligent shelving for perishable goods and precision climate control.
description: EcoShelf extends product freshness through adaptive temperature zoning, humidity management, and predictive maintenance. Retailers reduce waste while maintaining product quality and compliance.
